name: Boom Brain Studio
bio: Laguna-based studio behind Agimat and the World Beyond, a 2D platformer based on Philippine mythology that launched on Kickstarter in August 2020.

name: Singles Alliance
bio: Label of solo developer Leoned Andrew Tumbaga, who made Agnostiko ORIGINS for Nintendo Switch (2024).

name: Anino Entertainment
bio: Manila studio, also known as Anino Games, that made Anito: Defend a Land Enraged (2003), described as the first game produced and designed entirely by a Filipino team.

name: Neuroticfly Games
bio: Developer of Aswang Hunter on Steam. Also the Steam publisher of Maiba Taya, Hapunan and Sabado.

name: Ranida Games
bio: Developer and publisher of BAYANI - Fighting Game (Steam, 2019).

name: Yikon Games
bio: Studio of developer Josef Yenko (Yikon). Hapunan, made in Unity, is its first official release.

name: Spacezero Interactive
bio: Team led by Joshua Bicoy and Alvin Arapoc, behind Jeepney Simulator (2023) and Jeepney Simulator 2 (2024).

name: Mark The Panda
bio: itch.io creator of Karinderya ni Mark, a cooking game in English and Tagalog.

name: Candy Cabinets Studio
bio: Developer of Mahika (coming soon on Steam).

name: Solitary Studios
bio: Developer of Maiba Taya (Steam Early Access, 2026) and publisher of MANDATO.

name: Nest Games
bio: Developer of MANDATO, published by Solitary Studios (coming soon on Steam).

name: Kiwi Dreams
bio: Developer of Sabado, published by Neuroticfly Games (Steam, 2026).

name: Murushii Studios
bio: Independent Philippine studio behind Taguan (2025) and Project Threshold.

name: Frozen Lake Software
bio: Developer and publisher of Water Delivery (Steam, 2024).
